sources.role: Official source archive: Swing frame, AWT input, media and snapshot code.

paths.path: No persisted config. Standalone command is `java sorcererII.SorcererFrame`; applet parameters refreshRate, sleepHack, scale, rom8k, snapshot, diska-d, tape1-2 and hardKeyMap are read at startup but never written.
paths.naming: Resources are relative to extracted working directory; no config or controller-map serializer.

paths.path: AWT KeyEvent input; standalone frame forwards keyPressed/keyReleased to doKey. hardKeyMap toggles fixed physical-key vs character mapping. No joystick backend.
paths.naming: Keyboard matrix is compiled; no persisted key map.

paths.path: User-selected guest media, not NVRAM: four disk units and two cassette units.
paths.naming: User-selected `.dsk` disk files and `.wav`/`.tape` tapes; writable output uses selected path; no automatic save sidecar.

paths.path: User-selected snapshot through Swing; applet snapshot parameter loads one. Debug F3 writes first.snp in cwd.
paths.naming: `.snp` raw 65564 bytes: 28-byte Z80 header + 65536-byte memory; mounted media are not serialized.

paths.path: Required resources under roms/, relative to extracted cwd.
paths.naming: exmo1-1.dat 2048 bytes, exmo1-2.dat 2048, exchr-1.dat 1024, diskboot.dat 256. Optional user ROM packs are 8 KiB `.ROM`; alternate exmon12 files are present but not default.
